Provides a resource to create a CBS disk backup.

> **NOTE:** The parameter `diskBackupQuota` in the resource `tencentcloud.Cbs.Storage` must be greater than 1.

    encrypt: false,

    tags: {

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/cbs"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		example, err := cbs.NewStorage(ctx, "example", &cbs.StorageArgs{
			StorageName:      pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			StorageType:      pulumi.String("CLOUD_SSD"),
			StorageSize:      pulumi.Int(100),
			AvailabilityZone: pulumi.String("ap-guangzhou-6"),
			ProjectId:        pulumi.Int(0),
			Encrypt:          pulumi.Bool(false),
			DiskBackupQuota:  pulumi.Int(3),
			Tags: pulumi.StringMap{
				"createBy": pulumi.String("Terraform"),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = cbs.NewDiskBackup(ctx, "example", &cbs.DiskBackupArgs{
			DiskId:         example.ID().ToIDOutput().ToStringOutput(),
			DiskBackupName: pulumi.String("tf-example"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```

package generated_program;

import com.pulumi.Context;
import com.pulumi.Pulumi;
import com.pulumi.core.Output;

import com.pulumi.tencentcloud.Cbs.StorageArgs;

import java.util.ArrayList;

public class App {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Pulumi.run(App::stack);
    }

    public static void stack(Context ctx) {
        var example = new Storage("example", StorageArgs.builder()
            .storageName("tf-example")
            .storageType("CLOUD_SSD")
            .storageSize(100)
            .availabilityZone("ap-guangzhou-6")
            .projectId(0)
            .encrypt(false)
            .diskBackupQuota(3)
            .tags(Map.of("createBy", "Terraform"))
            .build());

        var exampleDiskBackup = new DiskBackup("exampleDiskBackup", DiskBackupArgs.builder()
            .diskId(example.id())
            .diskBackupName("tf-example")
            .build());

    }
}

## Import



CBS disk backup can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cbs/diskBackup:DiskBackup example dbp-qax6zwvr
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
